query:
SELECT
                l.id AS "link_id!"
            FROM
                public.email_links l
            WHERE
                l.macro_id NOT LIKE '%@macro.com'
                AND l.last_active_at < NOW() - (make_interval(days => $1))
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM public.email_user_history h WHERE h.link_id = l.id
                )
